jobs.title: Principal Geospatial Engineer
jobs.description:
This is not a traditional GIS role.

Lex & Winkle has partnered with an AI-native geospatial intelligence company transforming satellite imagery, aerial imagery and location data into commercial intelligence.

We're looking for a Principal Geospatial Engineer to own and build the geospatial intelligence capability underpinning the company’s products and platform.

Working directly with the Founder alongside the incoming technical team, you'll determine how they acquire, process, combine and operationalise imagery and spatial data at scale.

It's a role spanning geospatial engineering, software engineering, architecture, product and commercial thinking.

What you'll own

·   Geospatial architecture and technical roadmap
·   ArcGIS Enterprise deployment, administration and configuration on AWS
·   Geospatial intelligence systems and data pipelines
·   Satellite, aerial, cadastral, property and location datasets
·   AI-driven analysis of aerial imagery for property intelligence and risk assessment
·   Spatial data fusion, enrichment and automation
·   Spatial databases and geospatial infrastructure
·   APIs and services supporting commercial products
·   Remote sensing, imagery processing and spatial analytics
·   Integration between AI and geospatial capabilities

Your background might include

Geospatial software engineering, GIS development, remote sensing, Earth observation, location intelligence or geospatial product development. Candidates with backgrounds combining geospatial engineering plus AI, computer vision, or machine learning on imagery would be particularly interesting.

Technically, we're interested in experience across Python, PostGIS, ArcGIS Enterprise administration, GDAL, GeoPandas, spatial databases, APIs, AWS, raster and vector processing, satellite or aerial imagery, computer vision or ML on imagery, and production geospatial systems.

But this search isn't about finding someone who ticks every technology box. We're looking for a builder: someone who can operate at architecture level while remaining hands-on, navigate ambiguity and understand how sophisticated geospatial capability becomes a commercially useful product.

Australian citizenship and eligibility to obtain and maintain an Australian Government security clearance are required.

What’s on offer

Our client is a member of the Anthropic Claude Partner Network, NVIDIA Inception, and Amazon Startup Program. AFR AI Awards 2026 Sustainability finalist. Macquarie Incubator Most Appealing Investment 2025.

You'll join at a point where you can genuinely influence the platform, product and technical direction of the business, working at the intersection of AI, geospatial intelligence, remote sensing and satellite technology.

If you'd rather build a geospatial capability than inherit one, we'd like to talk.

Apply via LinkedIn or to Lex & Winkle including your CV to (careers@lexwinkle.com.au quote: TS00GEO) for a confidential conversation.

jobs.title: Geospatial Technician
jobs.description:
TWM is seeking an experienced Geospatial Technician
to support our industry-leading Geospatial team in Franklin, Tennessee. This position is ideal for someone with land surveying or construction experience who is interested in using the latest surveying technology while continuing to grow their skills.

Experience Level:
2+ years preferred but not required

Schedule:
Full-time, 40 hours / week, with the possibility of overtime

Salary:
$23.00 - $26.00 per hour – salary is commensurate with experience

Location:
Based in Franklin, TN

Essential job functions:

Perform mathematical calculations
Read/comprehend plans
Use robotic total stations and GPS equipment
Perform various survey-related tasks (e.g. ALTA, boundary, topographic surveys, and construction layout)
Ability/Desire to work outdoors in all weather and often as a 1-person crew
Ability/Desire to work in the office part time doing various tasks

Qualifications Desired:

Minimum of 2 years of land surveying or construction experience a plus, but prefer field crew chief or field/office combined surveying experience
High school diploma required. Associate of Science degree in a relevant field is a plus.
Proficiency in Trimble equipment and Trimble Access is a plus
Proficiency in AutoCAD and/or Microstation is a plus
High-Definition Laser Scanning experience a plus
Team-oriented and self-motivated
Ability/Desire to learn quickly and work independently
Willingness to work hard and efficiently
Attention to detail
Valid driver's license required
Ability to pass drug/alcohol test and background check is required

Benefits Summary:

Competitive salary and fringe benefit package. Starting salary is dependent upon personal knowledge, skill, and ability. Regular salary reviews, exceptional performance-based bonus incentives, non-contributory Employee Stock Ownership Plan, insurance, 401K, holidays, Paid Time Off and more. For a comprehensive list of our benefits, please visit our benefits page.

TWM is an established but growth-oriented consulting firm offering Civil and Structural Engineering, Surveying, and other Geospatial services. Named a Top Workplace, TWM prides itself on its culture. We are large enough to handle unique and challenging projects, but small enough to maintain a personal, family-oriented atmosphere where our team members are more than just a number. They are talented individuals who are passionate about their work and about providing clients with Exceptional Service. Nothing Less.

TWM is an EEO/M/F/Vet/Disabled employer.
